# Assignment 4 — Convolutional Neural Networks

Released: September 25. Due: October 13, 23:59.
Total points: 100.

## Tasks
1. Implement a CNN from scratch and train it on CIFAR-10.
2. Analyze the effect of batch normalization.
3. Write a report of at most 4 pages.

## Submission
Submit report.pdf and code.zip through the course portal before the deadline.
